sloka: ततः प्रभाते विमले विश्वामित्रम् तपोधनम्।उवाच राघवो वाक्यम् कृत आह्निकम् अरिन्दमः ॥१-४५-५॥
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale viśvāmitram tapodhanam।uvāca rāghavo vākyam kṛta āhnikam arindamaḥ ॥1-45-5॥

translations.english: "O Noble ascetic we have heard this great story worthy to be listened. As we both lay pondering over the entire story (narrated by you), the glorious night passed off just like a moment.
